entries.title: Bridge Budget 2026.10.13.2
entries.body:
- **Bill reminders:** turn them on in Settings, Bill reminders, and you get a notification at 9:00 the day before a bill in Schedules is due, with what it comes to. Works where Bridge Budget is on your Home Screen (iPhone and iPad) or in the Dock (Mac), and in browsers that show notifications. Each device is turned on separately.
- **Bill targets show the amount:** a category that saves for a bill now shows what the bill comes to and when it is due, and the total when it saves for several.

entries.title: Bridge Budget 2026.10.11.11
entries.body:
- **Loans stay one schedule:** Until paid off no longer adds a separate last-payment schedule. When the last payment is next, the amount drops to the smaller remainder by itself, so it is expected and budgeted at exactly that. Loans made with the previous version are turned into one schedule automatically.
- **First payment starts today** when you choose Until paid off.
- **Connect your assistant** now sits under Ask your assistant on the budget.

entries.title: Bridge Budget 2026.10.11.9
entries.body:
- **Loans and instalments:** a schedule can be paid Once, Repeat, or run Until paid off. Enter the total and what you pay per month, and Bridge Budget works out the payments. A smaller last payment gets its own schedule, so it is expected and budgeted at exactly that amount.
- **Connect your assistant from the budget:** until Claude or ChatGPT is connected, a button at the top of the budget takes you straight to the steps.

entries.title: Bridge Budget 2026.10.11.4
entries.body:
- **Choose how long a bill runs:** a repeating schedule now has a How long field: until you stop it, for a number of months, for a number of payments or until a date. It shows how many payments that comes to and the date of the last one.
- **Picking a payee fills in the rest:** a new schedule takes the account, amount and budget category from that payee's last payment.
- **New schedules start as one-off payments:** tick Repeats, right next to the date, for a recurring bill. The date you picked stays.
- **Colours in every category list:** moving money, covering overspending and picking a category show balances green when funded, amber when short of the target and red when overspent. Money coming in goes to Ready to Assign, and Starting Balances is gone from the list.
- **Works offline, syncs by itself:** changes made without a connection are kept, and Bridge Budget now reconnects and syncs them as soon as your server is reachable again, without a reload.
- **Tidier schedule editor:** notes grow as you type, Add and Cancel are always in view, and notes show an icon on the phone.

entries.title: Bridge Budget 2026.10.11
entries.body:
- **Money that comes in counts toward targets:** a refund, a repayment or money from someone else now funds a category's bill or save-by-date target, like in YNAB. A bill that is already covered shows as funded instead of asking for more.
- **Renaming a schedule no longer breaks its target:** the target follows the schedule when you rename it, and a deleted schedule's bill comes off its category's target instead of showing an error.
- **Schedule names with a colon** now work everywhere.

entries.title: Bridge Budget 2026.10.07.4
entries.body:
The first public release of Bridge Budget.

- **Switch from YNAB in a minute:** paste a YNAB personal access token and your accounts, transactions, schedules, monthly budgets and targets come across.
- **Bills can share a category:** put water, power and gas in Utilities and their amounts add up, each by its own due date.
- **Fund everything in one click:** Ready to Assign can fill every underfunded target at once, or cover everything you overspent.
- **Late payments:** a scheduled payment that has not arrived shows as *Expected, not arrived*. If it turns up within 30 days, it still links to its schedule and lands in its category.
- **Notes on schedules:** jot down why a bill exists or who shares it. The note shows in the schedules list.
- **On your phone:** the budget, targets, reports and schedules all work in your phone's browser.
- **Undo and Redo:** buttons on the budget, or Cmd+Z and Shift+Cmd+Z.
- **Privacy mode:** hide every amount with one click.
- **Download logs:** one file to email if something goes wrong, with account numbers and passwords masked.
- **Updates:** Bridge Budget tells you when a new version is out, with the one command to install it, and saves a copy of your budgets first.
